demos.title: Second Reality
demos.description: Start here: a showcase of classic VGA effects and tracker music.
demos.notes: Choose Sound Blaster; SB playback needs 1 MB EMS. Both disks are installed.

demos.title: Unreal
demos.description: The earlier Future Crew megademo; a good companion to Second Reality.
demos.notes: Version 1.1 (1993 bugfix release). Choose Sound Blaster in its setup.

demos.title: Panic
demos.description: A compact, energetic bridge between Unreal and Second Reality.
demos.notes: The Party 1992 production, debugged release in 1993. SB needs 1 MB EMS.

demos.title: Crystal Dream
demos.description: An early 16-colour production with a distinctive visual style.
demos.notes: Choose Sound Blaster. Original requirements start at a 12 MHz 286.

demos.title: Crystal Dream II
demos.description: Triton's larger follow-up, pairing polished effects with a strong soundtrack.
demos.notes: Choose Sound Blaster in the original startup screen.

demos.title: Stars: Wonders of the World
demos.description: A move toward the textured 3D look of the mid-1990s.
demos.notes: 2014 corrected-object DOS executable; originals retained. Supports SB/SB16.

demos.title: Caero
demos.description: A later DOS showcase with a different pace and visual direction.
demos.notes: Final release with Sound Blaster, GUS and no-sound support.

demos.title: Inside
demos.description: A music-led production that broadens the pack beyond the early VGA era.
demos.notes: Setup runs first: choose Sound Blaster and save. Requires 5.5 MB free memory.

demos.title: Fishtro
demos.description: Bonus: a short, playful intro for a change of pace between full demos.
demos.notes: Sound Blaster intro; original executable and archive are preserved.
